metadata.scope: Synthetic fixed-charge Coulomb surrogate, not an electronic-structure or bulk convergence claim.
metadata.qm_model: E=sum(q_QM*q_MM/r) in atomic units; no QM internal potential, polarization or periodic sum.
metadata.relative_energy: B minus A; errors relative to largest case within each scan.
metadata.force_errors: RMS and maximum Euclidean force-vector error over probe atoms and both states A/B.
metadata.qm_embedding_force: QM energy derivative on both QM and MM atoms; total adds native MM force.
metadata.nve_integrator: Explicit velocity Verlet CustomIntegrator; same-time OpenMM getState kinetic energy.
metadata.nve_controls: All QM/MM atoms move; fixed box; no thermostat, barostat, constraints or COM removal.
metadata.nve_event_jump: QM energy difference at the same event geometry using new versus old molecular image.

box_scan.protocol: Fixed contents and Cartesian A/B states; box dilation changes density and selected images.

extent_scan.protocol: Nested neutral whole molecules; fixed local geometry and underlying lattice density.
extent_scan.cavity: Origin lattice site omitted for QM region; every cell contains one vacant lattice site.
